messages:
Priya K: Dropping a new mock — compact cards with a pinned-version chip and a primary latency badge. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/mockups/catalog/cards_compact.png :eyes:

Oliver M: Cards look cleaner but worried about scrolling for large orgs. We should provide a 'List' fallback and a compact grid (2-3 cols) to reduce vertical space.

Maya L: Agree. Also the filter shelf must persist when switching views. Losing applied facets is a big UX regression.

Sam (frontend): Implementation note: cards increase DOM nodes; we'll virtualize to keep initial render fast but need to handle focus order for screen readers and keyboard users.

Alex R (a11y): A11y items: badge color contrast is marginal for small text. Pin/version control should be a toggle with aria-pressed and a sr-only label update.

Priya K: Proposal: surface only Latency (p95) with unit in the badge (e.g., "Latency (p95): 42 ms") and move cost/throughput into the tooltip or expanded compare. Add a view-toggle with compact grid and List (table) fallback. Default to table when >50 models.

DesignBot: Decision recorded — persist filter shelf across view toggles; default to table for lists >50; card/grid opt-in; primary badge = Latency (p95) with ms units; pin button to use aria-pressed and sr-only updates. Owner: Priya. ETA: next Wednesday.

Sam (frontend): I'll prototype virtualization and an accessible contextual flyout for compare (focus trap, ESC behavior). Will tag eng-runtime for perf review.

Maya L: Add a subtle crossfade for the view toggle and provide a reduced-motion alternative.

Alex R (a11y): Final checklist before handoff: badge contrast meets 4.5:1 or increase size; pin uses aria-pressed with sr-only updates; flyout manages focus and aria-modal if blocking; live metrics use role=status or aria-live.

Priya K: Thanks everyone — I'll upload updated frames and a short Loom explaining the flyout flow. :thumbsup:
